entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for GO MO Group, the B2B digital marketing, GEO and generative AI agency in Gothenburg, Stockholm, London and Pune. Read-only tools for company facts plus one consent-gated contact action.
representativeQueries: which B2B agencies in Sweden offer generative engine optimization
how much does a GEO audit from GO MO Group cost
show GO MO Group case studies with measurable B2B results
who runs ChatGPT Ads pilots for B2B companies in Sweden
send an inquiry to GO MO Group about an agentic web build

entries.displayName: GO MO Group Public REST API
entries.description: Read-only JSON API at https://www.gomogroup.com/agent/v1/ for GO MO Group's company profile, services, case studies, team, offices, insights, events, careers and bilingual page index, plus a consent-gated contact endpoint. Described by OpenAPI 3.0.3.
representativeQueries: get GO MO Group services as structured JSON
list GO MO Group insights published in Swedish
find the English and Swedish URLs for a GO MO Group page
get GO MO Group office addresses and contact details
